plugins.name: getsign
plugins.description: Send documents for signature from monday.com boards in plain language. Upload and map a new document, onboard an account that has never installed GetSign, and chase who still hasn't signed — every step in the order the GetSign API actually requires. Built on the official GetSign MCP server.
